title: Grid Garden - Daily Garden
description: Play the same solvable garden as everyone on each UTC day, then retry to improve your move count. Share its code, or return to the original gardens and random generator; unassisted best scores stay on this browser. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement.
controls: Click or tap a tile to change it and its orthogonal neighbours.
Tab into the garden, move focus with arrow keys, then use Space or Enter.
Undo reverses a move. Hint highlights a useful tile. Reset starts the current garden again.
New garden grows a fresh solvable 4×4 garden; Original gardens returns to the four classics. Progress resumes automatically on reload.
Today's garden opens the UTC daily challenge; Select code lets you copy its GG1-YYYYMMDD code.
Paste a daily code and choose Play code to replay it; Retry this code starts the same board again.
Hints mark an attempt as assisted; only completions without hints update the local best move count.
